scripts.build: bun run scripts/lib/run-locked-cmd.ts build NODE_ENV=production next build
scripts.biome:check: bun run scripts/lib/run-locked-cmd.ts biome:check bunx @biomejs/biome check --write --unsafe .
scripts.tsgo: bun run scripts/restore-next-env-dts.ts && bun run scripts/lib/run-locked-cmd.ts tsgo tsgo -b --noEmit
scripts.test: bun run scripts/lib/run-locked-cmd.ts test bun --env-file=.env.test test --timeout=60000
scripts.test:coverage: bun run scripts/lib/run-locked-cmd.ts test:coverage bun --env-file=.env.test test --coverage --timeout=60000
scripts.test:db:sequential: bun run scripts/lib/run-locked-cmd.ts test:db:sequential bun --env-file=.env.test test backend/db/test/ --timeout=60000
scripts.test:db:coverage: bun run scripts/lib/run-locked-cmd.ts test:db:coverage bun --env-file=.env.test test --coverage backend/db/test/ --timeout=60000
scripts.test:services:sequential: bun run scripts/lib/run-locked-cmd.ts test:services:sequential bun --env-file=.env.test test backend/services/ --timeout=60000
scripts.test:services:coverage: bun run scripts/lib/run-locked-cmd.ts test:services:coverage bun --env-file=.env.test test --coverage backend/services/ --timeout=60000
scripts.test:cron: bun run scripts/lib/run-locked-cmd.ts test:cron bun --env-file=.env.test test backend/services/cron/test/ backend/db/test/repo/cron.repository.test.ts backend/lib/cron-auth.test.ts app/api/cron/ --timeout=60000
scripts.test:integration:sequential: bun run scripts/lib/run-locked-cmd.ts test:integration:sequential bun --env-file=.env.test test test/integration/ --timeout=120000
scripts.test:graphql: bun run scripts/lib/run-locked-cmd.ts test:graphql bun run test/scripts/run-server-tests.ts
scripts.test:graphql:coverage: bun run scripts/lib/run-locked-cmd.ts test:graphql:coverage bun run test/scripts/run-server-tests.ts --coverage
scripts.test:simulate: bun run scripts/lib/run-locked-cmd.ts test:simulate bun --env-file=.env.test test --parallel=1 test/simulate/ --timeout=120000
scripts.test:ui:components: bun run scripts/lib/run-locked-cmd.ts test:ui:components TEST_SERVER_MODE=production bun --env-file=.env.test.ci test --parallel=1 test/ui/components/ --preload ./test/ui/test-env.ts --preload ./test/ui/components/happydom-preload.ts --preload ./test/ui/components/translation-preload.ts --preload ./test/ui/components/next-dynamic-mock.ts
scripts.test:ui:components:coverage: bun run scripts/lib/run-locked-cmd.ts test:ui:components:coverage TEST_SERVER_MODE=production bun --env-file=.env.test test --parallel=1 --coverage test/ui/components/ --preload ./test/ui/test-env.ts --preload ./test/ui/components/happydom-preload.ts --preload ./test/ui/components/translation-preload.ts --preload ./test/ui/components/next-dynamic-mock.ts
scripts.test:ui:e2e: bun run scripts/lib/run-locked-cmd.ts test:ui:e2e bun run test/scripts/run-server-tests.ts --e2e test/ui/e2e/
scripts.test:ui:static: bun run scripts/lib/run-locked-cmd.ts test:ui:static TEST_SERVER_MODE=production bun --env-file=.env.test test --parallel=1 test/ui/mobile-desktop-isolation.test.ts --preload ./test/ui/test-env.ts
scripts.test:ui: bun run test:ui:components && bun run test:ui:static
scripts.build:test: bun run scripts/lib/run-locked-cmd.ts build:test bun run test/scripts/build-test.ts
scripts.test:live-fx: bun run scripts/lib/run-locked-cmd.ts test:live-fx bun --env-file=.env.test test --preload ./test/integration/preload/live-fx-preload.ts test/integration/fx/ --timeout=120000
scripts.test:live-comm: bun run scripts/lib/run-locked-cmd.ts test:live-comm bun --env-file=.env.test test --preload ./test/integration/preload/live-comm-preload.ts test/integration/communication/ --timeout=120000
scripts.check:deps: bun run scripts/lib/run-locked-cmd.ts check:deps depcruise --config .dependency-cruiser.js app backend frontend shared
scripts.postinstall: rm -rf node_modules/*/node_modules/typescript && bun -e "const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); const tsDir = 'node_modules/typescript/lib'; const ts6Dir = 'node_modules/@typescript/typescript6/lib'; if (fs.existsSync(ts6Dir)) { for (const f of fs.readdirSync(ts6Dir)) { const target = path.join(tsDir, f); if (!fs.existsSync(target)) fs.writeFileSync(target, 'module.exports = require(\"@typescript/typescript6/lib/' + f + '\");\n'); const cjsTarget = target.replace(/\.js$/, '.cjs'); if (target.endsWith('.js') && !fs.existsSync(cjsTarget)) fs.writeFileSync(cjsTarget, 'module.exports = require(\"@typescript/typescript6/lib/' + f + '\");\n'); } } const file = 'node_modules/typescript/lib/version.cjs'; if (fs.existsSync(file)) fs.writeFileSync(file, 'module.exports = { ...require(\"@typescript/typescript6\"), version: \"7.0.2\", versionMajorMinor: \"7.0\" };'); const pkg = 'node_modules/typescript/package.json'; if (fs.existsSync(pkg)) { const p = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(pkg, 'utf8')); if (p.type === 'module') { p.type = 'commonjs'; fs.writeFileSync(pkg, JSON.stringify(p, null, 2)); } }"
scripts.test:graphql:sqlite: TEST_ENV_FILE=.env.sqlite bun run scripts/lib/run-locked-cmd.ts test:graphql:sqlite bun run test/scripts/run-server-tests.ts
